text: dsh-control-bar 是 DSH 桌面插件，会在屏幕顶部显示 Electron 置顶状态栏，呈现 agent 回合进度、当前操作说明和 DeepSeek 峰时或谷时。它监听回合与工具调用自动更新状态，也提供 control_bar 工具和命令行供手动设置进度；peak_valley 工具可查询时段及下一次切换时间。插件还按峰谷和 token 阈值提示大额操作确认。适合希望在其他窗口中也能看见 DSH 操作状态、并关注 DeepSeek 时段计价的桌面用户。显示状态栏需要本机 Electron。

dsh-control-bar shows DSH progress, activity, and DeepSeek peak or off-peak status in a desktop bar. Turn and tool events update it automatically; manual controls set progress, and peak_valley reports pricing periods. Large operations prompt during peak hours. Electron is required.
想让 DSH 操作电脑时在屏幕上一直显示进度。
希望每次 DSH 工具调用时状态栏自动更新当前在做什么。
Show DSH turn progress in a desktop overlay that stays above other windows.
dsh-control-bar 的功能「回合进度显示」：DSH 回合开始时显示状态栏，每次工具调用更新活动说明和进度，回合结束或报错后显示完成状态并自动收起。
dsh-control-bar 的功能「峰谷时段提示」：状态栏和 peak_valley 工具展示当前 DeepSeek 峰时或谷时、倍率及下次切换信息；配置可调整时区、时段和节假日。
dsh-control-bar README · Introduction：

dsh-control-bar README · dsh-control-bar：Whenever the agent starts driving your computer (moving the mouse, typing, running commands
that change state), a slim status bar stays pinned to the top of the screen: **正在操控**
(“controlling”) plus what it is doing right now, an honest percentage, and a badge telling you
whether DeepSeek is currently in **peak** or **off-peak** pricing hours.

dsh-control-bar README · dsh-control-bar：Peak tokens cost twice as much as off-peak ones, so the plugin also ships a policy:
**expensive operations ask for your confirmation during peak hours, and just run off-peak.**

dsh-control-bar README · Install：In DSH Desktop: **Plugins → Plugin Market**, search `dsh-control-bar`, install, restart.
Or from a CLI (`desktop` = your profile name):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-control-bar
```

Or straight from the repository (same thing before the npm release; there is no build step):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:JianGuo396/dsh-control-bar
```

dsh-control-bar README · Install：The bar is a separate Electron process, so it needs an Electron binary. Lookup order:
`overlay.electronPath` → `DSH_CONTROL_BAR_ELECTRON` → `DSH_ELECTRON_PATH` → `$DSH_HOME/electron`
→ `~/.dsh/electron` (installing [dsh-pet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pet) puts one there).
If nothing is found the bar is skipped, everything else keeps working, and the host logs
`overlay not running (electron-not-found)`.

dsh-control-bar README · Usage：Nothing to do after installing, and nothing the model has to remember — the bar follows the agent's
**turn**, the same way codex's status line does:

| Host event | Bar |
|---|---|
| `turn/start` | appears with "正在工作" / "正在处理你的请求" at 4% |
| every `tool/call` | label switches to what is happening (执行命令 / 读写文件 / 查资料 / 操作浏览器…), progress advances on a monotonic curve |
| `turn/end` or `agent/error` | fills to 100% ("完成"), waits 1.2 s, then hides itself |

dsh-control-bar README · Usage：A turn that is interrupted, fails, or is simply forgotten can no longer leave a bar hanging on screen.
`control_bar` still works (`start`/`update`/`finish`/`hide`) when the model wants to report an exact
percentage while driving your desktop.

Manual control, also handy from scripts:

```sh
dsh-control-bar 35 "opening the browser to search"
dsh-control-bar hide
dsh-control-bar peek                       # current phase + next switch
dsh-control-bar overlay start|stop|status

dsh-control-bar README · Peak / off-peak windows：| | Beijing time | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Peak | Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 (UTC 01:00–04:00, 06:00–10:00), excluding statutory holidays | ×2 |
| Off-peak | everything else, including weekends and holidays | ×1 |

Off-peak rates are half of peak rates per DeepSeek's pricing notes. Public holidays for 2026 are
bundled, so the check needs no network. Override `pricing.windows` / `pricing.holidays` if your
account uses a different schedule.

dsh-control-bar README · Peak / off-peak windows：Gate rules written into the system prompt: during peak, a large token operation (default
threshold ≈ 200k tokens) must write `text:"峰时大额操作，等你确认"`, ask you with three options
(do it now / wait for off-peak / narrow the scope) and only continue after you pick one; off-peak
it just runs; small reads are never gated.

dsh-control-bar README · Privacy：No network calls, no telemetry. The overlay only reads a local `state.json` (a number and a
string). Its renderer is sandboxed, unfocusable, and click-through, so it never blocks the window
you are working in.
